statement: Pinned Dolphin has distinct real-Wiimote transport and ControllerInterface consumers. The Linux real Bluetooth path opens HID L2CAP control and interrupt sockets; the HIDAPI path directly reads/writes Wii reports; WiimoteReal can forward raw input to emulated console Bluetooth. ControllerInterface independently decodes sensor states for generic controller input. A Bluetooth-bus UHID report device is not actual radio pairing, an L2CAP endpoint or USB Bluetooth adapter passthrough.
